name: A 658-Concept Family with Disconnected Attainable Sinks
definition: Glue two copies $K_1,K_2$ of the certified 330-concept marked-edge piece along their common edge $D=\{u,v\}$, using disjoint private coordinates and reversing the ordered endpoints in the second copy. Their marked-edge profiles are $(0,1,0,1,0)$ and $(0,0,1,0,1)$.
parameters: $|H|=658$ and the isometric dimension is $25$. Cartesian powers $H^m$ are defined for every $m\ge1$.
properties: $H$ is ample and corner-peelable, but the graph induced by $\operatorname{Sink}(H)$ is disconnected. Neither boundary vertex $u$ nor $v$ is attainable, while each private side contains an attainable sink. The sink graph of $H^m$ has at least $2^m$ connected components.
